audit_type: Authenticated Deep CIS Benchmark & Vulnerability Audit
credentials_profile: Domain Admin & SSH Key (Privileged Access Audit)

vulnerabilities.title: Linux Kernel Local Privilege Escalation (Dirty Cred)
vulnerabilities.description: Authenticated audit discovered unpatched cls_route filter flaw in Linux kernel allowing local unprivileged user to escalate to root.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update kernel packages to 5.14.0-284.25.1.el9_2 or higher and reboot system.

vulnerabilities.title: PostgreSQL Plaintext Superuser Password in Local Config
vulnerabilities.description: Authenticated file audit identified plaintext administrative credentials stored in /var/lib/pgsql/data/pg_hba.conf and environment profile.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Migrate database authentication to scram-sha-256 and remove plaintext credentials from local files.

vulnerabilities.title: SSH Root Login Permitted via Password Authentication
vulnerabilities.description: SSHD configuration permits direct root login with password authentication contrary to CIS Benchmark 5.2.10.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Set 'PermitRootLogin no' and 'PasswordAuthentication no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart sshd.

vulnerabilities.title: Unencrypted Database Backup Directory with World-Readable Permissions
vulnerabilities.description: Cron automated database dump directory has 0777 permissions allowing any local user to read customer transactional tables.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Enforce chmod 0700 on backup storage directories and encrypt dump archives with GPG.
